experiment_title: Module 2 Granular Shredder Anti-Forensic Residual Traces

positive_control.description: Target file extents, slack space, and Alternate Data Streams wiped cleanly
positive_control.observed: 0 bytes surviving across primary stream and 3 Alternate Data Streams

negative_control.description: Neighboring unaffected cluster data preserved without collateral corruption
negative_control.observed: Adjacent files on volume remain 100% bit-identical (SHA-256 verified)

limitations: Active Volume Shadow Copies (VSS) retain historical snapshots of files if created prior to shredding. Void Vault issues a prominent warning requiring operator authorization to delete VSS shadow copies.
